original.revision: 01.00 (from the Killzone Trilogy disc's PS3_EXTRA package)

approach: Static recompilation of the PPU and SPU code to C++ with ps3recomp v0.19.0 and this project's patches, HLE system libraries, Vulkan RSX backend
help: Testing on other GPUs (AMD, Intel) and CPUs
Testing on a clean Windows machine
Comparing each level with the PS3 game
notes: Needs your own copy of the game (the US Killzone HD, from the Killzone Trilogy disc or the PlayStation Store, or the European edition, NPEA00418 or BCES-01743; your RPCS3 install or the decrypted EBOOT; no firmware); the build happens on your PC. Playable: the whole campaign, levels 1 to 11, played from start to end on Linux and on Windows; 60 fps by default, an optional 144 Hz mode.
